# Pokemon Arena Battle Game — Plan

## Context
Single-file standalone HTML game where two Pokemon bounce around an arena and automatically battle on collision. Player picks their Pokemon and an opponent from a roster, each with unique stats.

---

## Output
**File:** `~/pokemon-arena.html` (single self-contained HTML file, no dependencies)

---

## Pokemon Roster (8 characters, all different stats)

| Name      | Emoji | HP  | Attack | Speed | Color    |
|-----------|-------|-----|--------|-------|----------|
| Charizard | 🔥    | 150 | 25     | 3     | #FF6B35  |
| Pikachu   | ⚡    | 90  | 20     | 5     | #FFD700  |
| Bulbasaur | 🌿    | 120 | 15     | 3     | #78C850  |
| Squirtle  | 💧    | 110 | 18     | 3.5   | #6890F0  |
| Mewtwo    | 🔮    | 200 | 35     | 4     | #9B59B6  |
| Snorlax   | 😴    | 250 | 10     | 1.5   | #A8A878  |
| Gengar    | 👻    | 80  | 40     | 4.5   | #705898  |
| Eevee     | 🦊    | 100 | 15     | 4     | #C8A85C  |

---

## Screens

### 1. Selection Screen
- Grid of 8 Pokemon cards (name, emoji, HP/ATK stats shown)
- Step 1: Player picks **their** Pokemon (highlighted in blue)
- Step 2: Player picks **opponent** Pokemon (highlighted in red)
- Cannot pick the same Pokemon for both
- "Start Battle!" button appears once both are selected

### 2. Battle Screen (Canvas)
- Arena: bordered rectangle, grass-textured background (CSS pattern)
- Both Pokemon rendered as colored circles with their emoji centered + name label
- Health bars at top (player left = blue, opponent right = red)
- Both bounce off arena walls with elastic physics
- **Collision detection:** when circles overlap → both take damage (attacker's attack value)
- Brief flash/shake animation on hit
- "FIGHT!" battle log text showing damage dealt

### 3. Game Over Screen
- "You Win!" or "You Lose!" message
- Shows final surviving Pokemon
- "Play Again" button → back to selection screen

---

## Implementation Details

### Physics
- Each Pokemon: `{ x, y, vx, vy, radius }`
- `radius` scaled to HP (bigger HP = slightly larger circle)
- On each frame: `x += vx`, `y += vy`
- Wall bounce: flip velocity component + clamp to bounds
- Collision: distance < r1 + r2 → deal damage, bounce apart (elastic reflection)
- Cooldown timer (0.5s) between collision damage ticks to avoid rapid damage spam

### Battle Logic
- On collision: each Pokemon deals its `attack` to the other simultaneously
- HP reaches 0 → game over
- Damage events shown as floating "+N" text particles rising from hit point

### Animation
- `requestAnimationFrame` loop
- Canvas 2D API for rendering
- No external libraries

---

## File Structure (single HTML file)
```
<html>
  <head> styles (CSS) </head>
  <body>
    #screen-select  (selection UI)
    #screen-battle  (canvas + HUD)
    #screen-gameover
    <canvas id="arena">
  </body>
  <script> all game logic </script>
</html>
```

---

## Verification
1. Open `pokemon-arena.html` in any browser — no server needed
2. Confirm 8 Pokemon cards render on selection screen
3. Pick two different Pokemon → Start Battle
4. Both Pokemon should bounce around arena and collide
5. HP bars decrease on collision
6. Game over screen appears when one reaches 0 HP
7. Play Again resets to selection screen

## Implementation Details

### Physics
- Each Pokemon: `{ x, y, vx, vy, radius }`
- `radius` scaled to HP (bigger HP = slightly larger circle)

- On collision: each Pokemon deals its `attack` to the other simultaneously
- HP reaches 0 → game over
- Damage events shown as floating "+N" text particles rising from hit point

- `requestAnimationFrame` loop
- Canvas 2D API for rendering
- No external libraries

Updated — visible in the preview panel!

Here's what was added:

**Mode Select Screen** — shown first, three ancient-styled cards:
- **AI vs AI** — fully automated, just watch
- **Player vs AI** — you control your Pokemon, AI controls the opponent
- **Player vs Player** — two humans share one keyboard/mouse

**Player Controls:**
- **P1** — `WASD` to move, `Left Click` to fire a ranged attack aimed at your cursor, `Right Click` to fire your special move (when the gold ring is pulsing)
- **P2 (PvP only)** — `Arrow Keys` to move, `,` for ranged attack, `.` for special

**Other changes:**
- Player-controlled Pokemon start stationary and accelerate smoothly with drag — feels like steering, not bouncing
- A crosshair follows your mouse on the canvas so you can see exactly where you're aiming
- A small direction arrow appears on your Pokemon when moving
- The HUD now has a thin **ranged attack charge bar** that fills up as your cooldown resets, so you can see at a glance when you can fire again
- The special move label pulses gold when ready to use
- AI opponents now occasionally steer toward you instead of purely bouncing randomly — keeps the fights active
- "Play Again" returns to the mode select screen
